title: Intent of a slice (Stage 0 of the protocol): goal, invariants, criticality and budget
description: Provided by a person with a2dlc run --intent <file>; the core validates it, copies it as-is to .a2dlc/run/<slice>/intent.json and the run is tied to that file (another intent on resume is an error). It is mounted at /in for the specifiers, the builders and the saboteur whenever it exists (§3; the builders and the saboteur are a deviation declared in the README); the Back-translator does not see it and the Inquisitor receives it only in the Stage 1.5 payload. The Stage 2 Router reads criticality, criticality_tags and critical_paths; CB-03 and the loop caps fall back to budget when the command line does not give them.

mode.description: Must match --mode; without --mode, a new run takes this one.

invariants.description: Known business invariants, as free text. The §6.2 DSL form is declared per invariant in the slice contract (invariants[].dsl). Stage 1.5 runs Z3 over the optional smt clauses of S*.

max_cost_usd.description: CB-03: cap on the cost reported by the roles. null = no cap. --max-cost-usd takes precedence over this.

max_inner_iterations.description: Cap on the Tier 0 loop (Stage 3). --max-inner takes precedence over this.

max_tier1_adversarial_rounds.description: Saboteur rounds in Stages 4 and 5. --max-rounds takes precedence over this.

max_mutants.description: Cap on mutants of Stage 5; takes precedence over config.mutation.max_mutants. null = config.mutation.max_mutants, or 30 if that is not set either.

max_tokens.description: Cap on the tokens the roles of the run may spend. null: no cap.

critical_paths.description: Globs (same syntax as config.paths). If a changed or deleted file from base to tree matches, the Router raises the criticality one level.

slas.description: Service-level objectives of the slice, each one a metric compared with a value in a unit (for example p99 latency < 200 ms). Absent or []: none.

change_kind.description: Kind of change, declared by the person. Absent: unknown.

criticality_tags.description: Domain tags of the slice. Any tag raises the effective criticality one level (once, however many tags there are), the same rule as critical_paths.

forbidden_imports.description: Imports the changed files may not use. They add to the repo's own prohibitions: the slice can only restrict further.

rejected_alternatives.description: Discarded alternatives (§6.3): the core passes them to the Builder in the @a2dlc header as rejected_alternatives. Absent: [].

boundary.description: Protected boundary of the slice (§7, CB-04): what the builder cannot touch. If Stage 3 crosses it, it escalates with protected_boundary; escalating privileges is a person's decision, who widens this boundary and re-runs (no waiver resolves it). Absent: there is no boundary.

delivery.description: Stage 7 (Progressive Delivery, §5): what the slice declares so the binary builds the delivery plan (delivery.json) that the platform executes. Without this section Stage 7 is left skipped with its reason. writes: the slice writes data; then compensation is mandatory to go past the 1 % ring (CB-06): without it (null or absent) the plan stays at max_ring 1 and the run escalates missing_compensation.

strategy.description: §5 Stage 7 step 3: compensating events, a data repair script, or records marked with the slice version to isolate them.

rings.description: Percentages of the canary rings, strictly increasing and ending at 100. Absent: 1, 10, 100.

read_only_paths.description: Globs of the paths the slice reads and must not write. Parity of the legacy and the new code runs on them in refactor (delivery.parity.paths).

error_rate_delta_max.description: Rollback Sentinel: maximum error-rate delta against the previous ring. null: the platform sets it.

invariants.description: Runtime invariant assertions. Absent: the intent's invariants.

criticality.description: Criticality of the slice. Order: low < medium < high < critical. The tags of criticality_tags raise the effective level one step, the same rule as critical_paths.

boundary.description: What the builder cannot change (§7, CB-04). With forbidden_paths, a file in /work that matches a glob escalates. With do_not_refactor, a changed file whose added or removed lines contain the symbol as a whole word escalates: it is a textual heuristic, so it also flags a new call site.

forbidden_paths.description: Globs (same syntax as config.paths): no file that matches may change in /work.

do_not_refactor.description: Identifiers whose lines cannot change (see the boundary description).

forbidden_side_effects.description: Side effects the changed code may not produce, by protocol name. Declared here; checking them is engine work.
